answer: Post-deployment monitoring can help mitigate risks from both asset gain and continual learning by continuously reassessing deployed models when new techniques around non-model gains emerge. This ongoing evaluation allows developers to maintain awareness of the adversarial landscape and to monitor for potential risks associated with the evolving capabilities of AI systems. Additionally, post-deployment monitoring can help identify and address issues related to continual learning, such as the risk of a previously safe model drifting into unsafe behaviors due to changes in knowledge or user interventions. By implementing robust monitoring practices, organizations can better manage the risks associated with both asset gain and the dynamic nature of AI learning processes.
